source_units.text: I am trying to make my brush strokes more deliberate in calligraphy practice.
Please schedule the mechanics I need to study.
The syllabus consists of "Stroke Entry", "Ink Loading", "Brush Pressure"; each named topic needs a minimum of 15 minutes in total.
My study window closes on 2027-02-07; that date is still available.
The total of all sessions on any one date must not exceed 70 minutes.
